panels.title: Sold
panels.description: Confirmed sold policies for the selected time range and filters.

panels.title: Transfers
panels.description: All VICIdial SALE dispositions in the selected range, including confirmed Sold calls.

panels.title: Conversion
panels.description: Sold / Transfers, where Transfers equals all VICIdial SALE dispositions.

panels.title: 30+ → Sold
panels.description: Share of 30+ minute calls that became sold policies.

panels.title: Below 20 min
panels.description: Share of SALE calls that did not reach the 20+ minute mark.

panels.title: Performance over time
panels.description: Sold, 30+ calls and transfers across the selected time range. Short ranges use hourly buckets; longer ranges use daily buckets.

panels.title: Volume overview
panels.description: Selected-range totals for Sold, 30+, and Transfers. Transfers is the full SALE-disposition total, so Sold is included inside Transfers.

panels.title: Top sellers
panels.description: Top agents ranked by Sold for the selected filters and time range.

panels.title: Agent leaderboard
panels.description: Agent performance. Transfers equals all SALE dispositions, including Sold. When Client / preset is All, resolved presets are added as dynamic columns showing each agent's SALE-disposition count for that preset.

panels.title: Team performance
panels.description: Team performance. Transfers equals all SALE dispositions, including Sold. Agent count is distinct agents with any real disposed call in the selected range. When Client / preset is All, resolved presets are added as dynamic columns showing each team's SALE-disposition count for that preset.

panels.title: Project performance
panels.description: Compare selected projects. Transfers equals all SALE dispositions, including Sold, and Agent count is distinct agents with any real disposed call in the selected range. The Project filter above supports selecting several projects at once.

panels.title: Client performance
panels.description: See which client/preset groups are converting. Transfers equals every SALE disposition for the client, including Sold.

panels.title: Sales and 30+
panels.description: Confirmed sales plus unsold 30+ sale-chance calls for the selected dashboard filters.
US state sales geography inferred from phone-number area codes. Transfer intensity is shown as a yellow halo; confirmed Sold calls appear as a dark-green core at the same state center.
panels.title: Transfers & Sold by state
Other SALE calls
panels.description: SALE dispositions that are neither Sold nor 30+. These are the remaining SALE calls after the Sales and 30+ table, and every column can be filtered directly from its header.

title: Convergence
description: Team-facing sales performance dashboard. Starts on today, puts Sold first, and keeps every view synchronized with the native Grafana filters.
